title: The many lies of PED users (part. 2)
summary: In the second part of his PED series, NH turns to health consequences and the excuses users make: addiction and the battered-spouse cycle, the fake warrior bravado, the 'Arnold is still alive' argument, TRT and PCT myths, and downsizing. He admits he nearly took PEDs in 2016-17, says he has no compassion for users who fall ill, and closes by calling PEDs a pact with the devil that trades lifespan for instant gratification.
claims: Anti-PED messaging often backfires: admitting that PEDs work makes audiences hear only 'it makes you big'
PED users contradict themselves by claiming the drugs do little while depending on them, spending everything on them and being unable to stop
In 2016-17 he was tempted by PEDs because he thought he had hit his natural limit, though he was still progressing at the time
What stopped him was meeting real PED users at gyms and online; seeing how grim their lives were turned him into an active opponent
As an immigrant, using PEDs (a felony) could have gotten him deported
There is no safe low dose: doses escalate the way they do with any hard drug
Rich Piana was the only honest PED user on YouTube because he openly said he was shortening his life
PED use works like a battered-spouse cycle: the good moments (pumps, libido, confidence) keep users hooked while the side effects pile up
The users he met said they were miserable almost all the time but kept going for brief moments of bliss
Many former heroin users who switch to exercise end up injecting steroids, swapping one needle habit for another
There is no controlled use of drugs: if you need the substance, the drug is in charge
It is far easier never to start PEDs than to quit them
The tough warrior image of PED users hides deep insecurity; they act fearless until a health scare, then cry for sympathy online
Arnold surviving proves nothing: he had wealth and top medical care, and most bodybuilders from the 70s-80s who failed to make it died early
Taking PEDs to make money from your physique is wrong and doesn't work; you will be one more account with 500 subscribers
Deaths of PED users are rarely blamed on the drugs even when the link is obvious, for example heart failure or depression and suicide
He feels no compassion for PED users who get sick, because they chose it, unlike a child with leukemia
Bodybuilding should be about health, longevity and mobility; PED use contradicts that by taking away your later years
Young men of 18 starting TRT is heartbreaking; what they need is to fix their life, environment and training
Like his generation of French teens who started smoking at 14-15, today's young TRT users will see the damage about 20 years later
Pro bodybuilders who announce they are downsizing were probably warned by their doctor that they will die; they rarely actually lose size
PED users say hormones don't matter when explaining their gains, then say gifted naturals win because of high natural testosterone
You do not need to take drugs to know they are bad; 'you can't judge if you haven't tried' is designed to shut down the discussion
Nobody really wants a short, intense life; everyone he visited in hospital with a terminal illness regretted it
Many side effects show up quickly rather than 15 years later, and the late ones tend to be heart attacks or cancer
Low-dose users stall again and then raise the dose, because they have shown they cannot progress without chemicals
PEDs amplify body dysmorphia instead of curing it
Gateway and slippery-slope effects are real: using a substance teaches your brain that chemicals are an acceptable way to reach a goal
Legitimate TRT prescribed by a real doctor for genuinely low testosterone exists; most 'TRT' is drug use
Evolutionary psychology is valid; calling it an appeal-to-nature fallacy ignores that humans are still animals
After coming off a cycle, even with PCT, users lose most of the muscle; he saw gym users melt despite eating and training hard
Failed PCT pushes users into blasting and cruising for life, which is why pros don't bother with PCT
Most men who think they have low T actually have a low-T lifestyle and should fix it before seeking a real doctor
Fake naturals hide their use because they know it is wrong
You do not need PEDs for money or women: there is little money left in fitness, and natural lifting gets you girls more easily
Pleasure is a by-product; making it the goal of life, as hedonism does, leads to destruction
No supplement gives muscle without side effects; the 'miracle' supplements that worked were banned because they were hormonal
Equivalent exchange: results without effort are paid for with your lifespan and quality of life
Health comes before muscle: when you get sick, the muscle disappears anyway
Asked whether he would take a side-effect-free muscle drug, he says no, because no such substance exists
